summary: Enterprise Suite AC-12 local runtime composition manifest catalogs router-ready HR, Payroll, Accounting, and Enterprise Suite route metadata with uniqueness validation while explicitly avoiding deployed listener, auth runtime, child network calls, storage integration, Workflow execution, cloud deployment, and runtime audit-chain emission claims.

findings: The composition is a small route catalog adapter with deterministic Vec assembly and BTreeSet uniqueness validation.
No listener startup, socket binding, async runtime, network client, storage adapter, or side effect is introduced.
A single manifest makes later gateway/cloud wiring observable without collapsing child runtime boundaries.
Capability flags keep listener, auth, child calls, storage, Workflow, cloud deployment, and runtime audit emission false until real integration slices land.

F3_adversarial.diagnostic_asserted: Tests fail if route count drifts, required child routes are missing, capability flags overclaim deployment/runtime integration, or duplicate method/path pairs are accepted.
findings: Positive route catalog coverage and negative duplicate route validation are both covered.
The crate exposes one composition function, one route record shape, and one uniqueness validator for later listener wiring.
Composition tests/clippy, Enterprise Suite package-group tests/clippy, 22-package enterprise regression tests/clippy, fmt, data_class scan, and quality-marker scan passed.

alternatives_named: merge child routers behind a gateway now
add local route composition manifest first
F6_alternatives.selected_rationale: The local manifest pins route metadata and uniqueness before claiming live listener, auth, networking, storage, or cloud deployment.
rejected_reasons: Real listener deployment requires auth, tenancy, storage/runtime wiring, observability, rollback, and SLO evidence beyond this slice.
Merging routers into a gateway would imply runtime dispatch semantics not proven here.

findings: No secrets, auth bypass, network listener, or child service clients are introduced.
Route records preserve request/response data-class labels so later gateway/auth work can enforce boundaries.

F8_performance.regression_baseline: Fixed-size route manifest over 19 routes; no runtime dispatch or I/O path exists.

findings.summary: Route assembly and uniqueness validation are bounded over a small in-memory vector; no network, filesystem, or database I/O is introduced.

findings: Route and composition public fields carry data_class annotations.
Capability response explicitly marks deployed listener, auth runtime, child calls, storage integration, Workflow execution, cloud deployment, and runtime audit-chain emission false.
The change is additive: one composition crate, catalog row, workspace membership, spec/tasks/evidence updates, and no runtime deployment or external resources.
Composed routes carry service, method, path, operation id, and data-class labels for future gateway audit/telemetry.
Enterprise Suite AC-12 and D-09 record the composition seam while deployed listener, auth, network calls, storage, Workflow, cloud, and runtime audit evidence remain future slices.

M1_challenge_assumption.premise_stated: A local route composition manifest can land before a deployed listener if it is explicitly metadata-only and all runtime/cloud capabilities stay false.
M1_challenge_assumption.premise_evidence_ref: specs/microservices/enterprise-suite.json AC-12 and local runtime composition tests
M1_challenge_assumption.do_nothing_consequence: Future cloud gateway/listener work would lack a tested cross-service route catalog and uniqueness guard.
M1_challenge_assumption.upstream_fix_rejection_reason: Child runtime crates already expose route manifests; the missing seam is cross-service composition metadata rather than child runtime behavior.

findings: This advances the enterprise suite from isolated router-ready adapters toward later Oyatie cloud listener integration without pretending a gateway is deployed.
Names follow Enterprise Suite local runtime composition, route catalog, and non-deployed capability vocabulary.
Enterprise Suite spec, plan, todo, evidence, catalog, and audit-chain references were updated.
Composition-specific code lives in a new Enterprise Suite crate; child runtime crates remain unchanged.
No listener, auth runtime, router merger, database, provider SDK, Workflow client, child-service network client, cloud adapter, or audit emitter was introduced.
No third-party dependencies were added; the crate depends only on existing HR, Payroll, Accounting, and Enterprise Suite runtime crates.
Route records include service/method/path/operation/data-class fields; no wire API schema is changed.
Composition deterministically maps existing child route manifests into a cross-service catalog and validates method/path uniqueness with a BTreeSet.
